{{Quote|The Conservator and his followers drove out all of the archaeologists who were studying these ruins, including the Selkath.|[[Qrukk]]|<ref name="TOR:ACP">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Imperial|A Conservative Proposal|Manaan}}</ref>}}
The '''Archaeology Center''' was an underwater archaeological research facility located within the [[Asutvu Rift]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. It was established to conduct excavation of the [[Ancient Selkath City]].<ref name="TOR:RitR" />
